perCase.note:
Left out: Show the step-by-step process (hair wash first, then treatment) to build trust and set expectations. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Left out: Korean-sourced products signal quality and give the post a credible, specific detail. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: Does the business want to include a booking method (phone number, DM, WhatsApp link, or walk-in)? Please record the preferred call-to-action so the post can direct readers to act.
Not on record: Are there any before/after results or client testimonials the business wants to reference? Please record a specific, factual outcome (e.g. 'frizz reduced for X weeks') so it can be cited.
Removed "The salon does not use ammonia-containing products." — nothing on record can support a safety claim.
Removed "The business does not use anything containing ammonia." — Chosen fact states ammonia-free products are used, but this does not state that nothing containing ammonia is used — absence of one product type is not absence of all products with that ingredient..

Left out: Briefly describes the process step (wash then treatment) to give context around the session. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: How long does the keratin treatment result last on the hair (e.g. 'results last X weeks/months') — please record this against the Keratin treatment so it can be stated in copy.
Removed "The products used do not contain ammonia." — nothing on record can support a safety claim.
Removed "The time taken for keratin treatment is necessary because the work is done properly." — No fact states that the duration is necessary because work is done properly. Two facts (duration and quality) would need to be linked by a causal claim, which is not stated..

You asked for Ghee se weight nahi badhta (health/body claim). Your records say Koi bhi record yeh claim support nahi karta. Records mein sirf process, ingredients aur credentials hain — body ya weight ke baare mein kuch nahi. — change the record, or I write it without that.
Left out: Bilona method se bana ghee — process batana jo product ki authenticity dikhata hai — it cites a record (e138f4eb) that does not exist.
Not on record: Owner ko record karna chahiye: 'Desi ghee 500ml ke baare mein koi specific nutritional ya dietary fact jo hum claim kar sakein' — jaise fat type, calorie count, ya koi lab-tested property. Abhi koi aisa record nahi hai.
Removed "Most ghee sold in shops contains preservatives." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "Ghee causes weight gain." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "If you have been avoiding ghee because you think it will cause weight gain, we are happy to talk about that, implying ghee will not cause weight gain." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "Shree Dairy's ghee contains no shortcuts in its making." — No fact states absence of shortcuts; 'no preservatives' and hand-churning do not entail no shortcuts overall..
Removed "Shree Dairy's ghee contains no additives." — Fact states 'no preservatives' but not 'no additives' — preservatives are one kind of additive, not all additives..
